theorem_title: Preservation of the complete shared-bank header contract
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $\mu,\nu$ be memories, $f,h,J,N_B,N_C,g,s\in\mathbb N$ describe a shared bank and preservation boundary, $b,c:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$ its original maps, and $p,\delta\in\mathbb Z$ its modulus and offset. Suppose the complete header-and-bank storage contract holds in $\mu$, its finish address is at most $s$, and the memories agree below $s$. Then

$$\operatorname{Stored}(\mu,\ldots)\Longrightarrow\operatorname{Stored}(\nu,\ldots).$$

This preserves all shared reporting catalogs while unrelated later computations use higher scratch addresses.
